mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.content, t.category_id as categoryId, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime, c.name as categoryName FROM tutorial t LEFT JOIN category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.category_id = #{categoryId}
